items.question: Do I need to speak Chinese?
items.answer: Not at all. Our platform and runners are fully multilingual (English, French, Chinese). You communicate with us in your language and we handle everything in Chinese on your behalf.

items.question: How fast are tasks completed?
items.answer: Most tasks are assigned within 30 minutes during business hours. Simple proxy orders are typically completed within 2 hours. Complex tasks like visa support may take 1–3 business days.

items.question: Is the membership worth it?
items.answer: If you place more than 2 proxy orders per month or need more than 1 hour of errand support, the membership pays for itself immediately. Members also receive 20% off all other services.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept international credit and debit cards via Stripe (Visa, Mastercard, Amex). This makes it easy for expats without Chinese payment apps set up.

items.question: Can I cancel my membership anytime?
items.answer: Yes. Cancel with one click from your dashboard. You retain access until the end of your current billing period with no penalties.

items.question: Is my personal information secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never share your information with third parties. Our platform uses bank-grade security via Supabase and Stripe.
